nfs2015-tf-cx11-rebuild-20261008.description: CX26.3 / Wine11.0 (athei/wine cx-26-patched 1a7b0c76 plus four patches) rebuilt on 2026-10-07/08 with x86 hardware execution-breakpoint delivery and the dxmt Metal Direct3D 11 backend
nfs2015-tf-cx11-rebuild-20261008.toolchainNote: Rebuilt 2026-10-07/08 from the patched source tree at HEAD 1e98e299 (base 1a7b0c76 plus four patches). PE builtins were built with Homebrew mingw-w64 GCC 16.1.0 (ntdll.dll reports GCC: (GNU) 16.1.0) rather than llvm-mingw clang, a known parity gap with CI that was not rebuilt for; the Mach-O binaries with Apple clang 21.0.0 (Xcode). Not bit-identical to profile nfs2015-tf-cx11: bin/wine and lib/wine/x86_64-unix/wine match it, bin/wineserver, lib/wine/x86_64-unix/ntdll.so and lib/wine/i386-windows/ntdll.dll differ. The PE ntdll.dll embeds the build folder and a link time, so it cannot match; the cause for the other two is not isolated. Behaviour was checked only by the execution-breakpoint fixture (2 failures with WINE_TF_EMULATION unset, 0 with it set), wine cmd /c ver and the compatibility selection, never with NFS16.exe or the EA client.
